title: A resolution notifying the House of Representatives of the election of a Sergeant at Arms and Doorkeeper of the Senate.
latestAction: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
summary: This resolution provides for the Senate to notify the House of Representatives of the election of the Honorable Jennifer A. Hemingway as Sergeant at Arms and Doorkeeper of the Senate.
